title: Heading of the admins' Settings page listing deleted Spaces. "Space" is a product noun (a shared area for a team's pages and chats); keep it capitalized if your language allows.
description: Explains what deleting a Space did and what restoring does. "socios" are the AI agents; their access to the Space is restored too.
item.deleted: Second line of a deleted Space's row. {{name}} is the person who deleted it (or "a former member"), <when></when> is the date and time it was deleted (keep the tags), {{count}} is how many pages the Space holds.
item.formerMember: Stands in for {{name}} in "Deleted by {{name}}" when the person who deleted the Space is no longer in the workspace.
item.when: The date and time a Space was deleted; only formats the date, adjust the style only if your locale needs it.
restore.label: Screen-reader label of the Restore button; {{name}} is the Space's name.
restore.done: Toast after a Space was restored; {{name}} is its name, in quotation marks (use your language's quotation marks).
